column3: Preserves the image “fruit of the womb” rather than “children”.
Preserves bearing “on my knees” and being “built up” rather than explicitly building a family.
Preserves “wrestlings of God” rather than “my great struggles”.
Does not add “hard” to the description of service.
Does not add the request “please stay”.
Preserves what the livestock was with him without adding “thrived”.
